public final class Example {

        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"udev\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("ACTION==\"add\", KERNEL==\"sd*\"", config);
